At the time of this interview, Zeke Mullins had begun his eighth decade as a jazz pianist. Zeke performed with The Lionel Hampton Band for twenty years, and became a member of The Harlem Blues and Jazz Band in 2015.
Zeke was interviewed in New Hartford, New York on June 9, 2017, by Monk Rowe, Director of the Fillius Jazz Archive.
My name is Monk Rowe and we are near Clinton, NY. I’m pleased to be talking with pianist Zeke Mullins today. Welcome.
And tomorrow, or later today, you’ll be playing up at Hamilton with the Harlem Blues and Jazz Band.
How long have you been working with these guys?
